create_got_ocr2_processor: create a GotOcr2Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for OCR text extraction from images
run_ocr_on_images: run OCR processing on images with optional bounding box, color filter, and multi-page document support
preprocess_box_annotation: preprocess a bounding box annotation by converting pixel coordinates to normalized [0, 1000] range based on image dimensions
build_formatted_ocr_prompt: build a formatted OCR prompt with image tokens, system query, and optional format output flag for structured text results
handle_multi_page_ocr: handle multi-page document OCR by flattening nested image lists and tracking page boundaries per batch
